records.issue_text: **`apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:60-65`** — Webhook secret comparison uses `!==` instead of a constant-time comparison (`crypto.timingSafeEqual`). This endpoint can create/overwrite arbitrary users' app credentials given a valid secret, so a timing side-channel on secret verification is a meaningful risk for a security-sensitive endpoint. Also `req.headers[...]` can be `string[]` (duplicate headers), which would always fail comparison — not a security hole, but worth normalizing.
